Error in lavParseModelString(model) :

The code I ran is as follows:

#model 1
ERN_ATTEN_ANX_data1Syntax  <- 
"total_anxiety ~ FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms + ACSFOCUS_finalreverse2x + ACSSHIFT_finalreverse2x + ERNXfocus + ERNXshift + ERNXfocusXshift

#residual variance
total_anxiety ~~ total_anxiety

#exo variances
ERNXfocusXshift ~~ ERNXfocusXshift
ERNXfocus ~~ ERNXfocus
ERNXshift ~~ ERNXshift
ACSFOCUS_finalreverse2x ~~ ACSFOCUS_finalreverse2x 
ACSSHIFT_finalreverse2x ~~ ACSSHIFT_finalreverse2x
FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms ~~ FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms

#covariances 
ERNXfocusXshift ~~ FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms
ERNXfocus ~~ FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms
ERNXshift ~~ FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms
ACSFOCUS_finalreverse2x ~~ ACSSHIFT_finalreverse2x
ERNXfocus ~~ ACSFOCUS_finalreverse2x  
ERNXfocusXshift ~~ ACSFOCUS_finalreverse2x 
ERNXfocusXshift ~~ ACSSHIFT_finalreverse2x 
ERNXshift ~~ ACSSHIFT_finalreverse2x 

#Intercepts
total_anxiety ~ 1

#regressions
#Model1
total_anxiety ~ FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms
total_anxiety ~ ACSFOCUS_finalreverse2x
total_anxiety ~ ACSSHIFT_finalreverse2x
total_anxiety ~ FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms + ACSFOCUS_finalreverse2x + ERNXfocus
total_anxiety ~ FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms + ACSSHIFT_finalreverse2x + ERNXshift
total_anxiety ~ FCz_Incorrect_meanamp_neg50to75ms + ACSFOCUS_finalreverse2x + ACSSHIFT_finalreverse2x + ERNXfocusXshift"

#run  Model 1
ERN_ATTEN_ANX_data1Run <- lavaan(ERN_ATTEN_ANX_data1Syntax, sample.cov = covMat_ERN, sample.nobs = 1000)

Also please excuse/forgive my horrendously long variable names. 

Any comments, thoughts, or suggestions are greatly appreciated!

Thanks!

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: lavaan ERROR: duplicate model element in:
parts:
Michelle,
Two things stand out for me.

First, your expression for the covariance matrix appears incomplete, missing a right bracket and right parenthesis.  However, that is the the reason for the error.

Second, a lavaan model syntax string provides model syntax for a single model.  You cannot include distinct models within the same model syntax string.  For example, the following two specifications specify the same model.

'Stooges ~ Larry + Curly + Moe'

'Stooges ~ Larry
Stooges ~ Curly
Stooges ~ Moe'

In both cases, there is just one equation for Stooges that predicts Stooges from Larry, Curly and Moe.

Syntax such as the following is not valid.

'Stooges ~ Larry + Curly
Stooges ~ Larry + Moe'

When the model syntax interpreter reaches the second Larry, it recognizes this as a duplicate of the first.  You cannot list Stooges ~ Larry twice in the same parameter table as two distinct parameters.  So, one of the Larrys has to be omitted in order to make the above syntax valid.

You have listed the same variable several times in your various lines beginning 'total_anxiety ~'.  That is the reason for the error.

Keith
